scenarios.name: Scenario A — Normal Baseline
scenarios.description: Standard university setting with 12 exams, 6 rooms (including 2 computer labs), and 15 time slots over 5 days.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Feasible 100% complete timetable with 0 hard conflicts.

scenarios.name: Scenario B — Restricted Resources
scenarios.description: Constrained environment where 2 lecture halls are decommissioned, leaving tight room availability.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Valid alternative schedule utilizing computer labs for eligible non-lab exams where capacity permits.

scenarios.name: Scenario C — Shared Student Clash
scenarios.description: Student Rahul Kumar and Priya Sharma are enrolled in both CS101 and CS102 with competing preferred morning slots.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Constraint engine prevents overlapping time slots for CS101 and CS102, spacing them across consecutive days.

scenarios.name: Scenario D — Exam Rescue Mode
scenarios.description: Room R203 suffers sudden HVAC malfunction mid-session while hosting EC101.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Emergency Rescue Engine reallocates EC101 to Room R102 while preserving all other 11 exam slots unchanged (91.6% timetable stability).

scenarios.name: Scenario E — Impossible Constraints
scenarios.description: Two fixed examinations involving the same cohort are simultaneously locked into Room R101 at 09:00 AM on 15 Apr 2025.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Engine halts immediately during Pre-Validation and outputs explainable Diagnostic Infeasibility Proof rather than fabricating an invalid schedule.
